method: Visual inspection of actual Blender renders; separate from automated solid and motion validation

views.observation: Straight yaw-bridge exterior walls and feet; no external mounting ears or vertical screwdriver troughs. Top cable passage and bearing ring retained for their respective functions.
Underside screw access in the existing deck; full lower frame legs visible. Internal PCB and load-bearing lands retained.
Continuous oval rear cover with two recessed rear screw heads; no side screw ears or open longitudinal driver trough. Lead exit and shell-boss mating clearance retained.
Simple chamfered central bottom plate with four inset recessed screw heads. Distinct bearing wings retained for radial wheel loads.
Circular split collar with screw head within the outer outline; no separate external clamp ears. Close-up deliberately excludes lower stem.

limitations: Visual review does not qualify printing, strength, acoustics or purchased fastener fits.
